projects.name: StrikeEngine
projects.description: A data-oriented C++23 aerospace simulation engine and GNC framework for 6-DOF missile engagements, featuring Vulkan GPU compute and a live terminal telemetry cockpit.

projects.name: StrikeCEM
projects.description: A Physical Optics radar cross-section (RCS) database generator in C++20/CUDA, computing high-frequency stealth signatures from 3D meshes for StrikeEngine.

projects.name: libxtm
projects.description: A C++20 geospatial terrain compression library and CLI featuring adaptive predictive coding, quadtree partitioning, and random-access Region-of-Interest decoding.
